title: Week ending October 31st
introTitle: Trying to run every road in Havertown, Pennsylvania
audio: silent master; add music in Instagram
description: A two-second goal card introduces the attempt to run every road in Havertown, Pennsylvania. Saturday ends with a brief gold burst and gentle map shake before the final stats fade in. Silent Reel master: add music in Instagram when posting. Sunday–Saturday calendar snapshot: older GPS history stays light purple, each active run draws in gold then turns dark blue. The teal 19083 ZIP outline draws in at the start. A gold day outline slides smoothly across the Sunday–Saturday calendar before each route begins. Average start updates using only the runs revealed so far. The map is zoomed in 12%. Weekly mileage, total running time and average start share one row and linger for four seconds. Mileage and pace use recorded Strava distance and moving time; average start is the circular mean in America/New_York. All weekly mileage is counted even if a run is outside the fixed Havertown map.
